column3: Dialog focus: while a dialog is open, focus that lands outside it (other than in a popover positioner) is pulled back in and remembered; on close the dialog returns focus to that element, else to its opener. lib/focus.ts returnTarget picks the first candidate still connected. The delete confirm now starts on Keep
column4: Ark's menu restores focus to its trigger after the dialog mounts, so the confirm opened with focus behind the scrim. Fixing it in the one Dialog shell covers every dialog a menu opens
